stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: Who have we no email for?
stations.note: The reminders go by email now.

stations.title: owners
stations.text: Some cells were never filled in.

captions: Winnie needs every owner the practice has no email for, so she can phone them.
Comparing with an empty cell is never true, so those owners quietly drop out.
You find, keep and fill the empty cells, in four tasks.
Now every owner without an email is on Winnie's list, and nobody is lost.
Same records, gaps and all. Every reminder reaches someone.
